notes: Partition verified: all 30 source morphemes and all 41 target tokens appear exactly once, across one two-source unit (lə + ʿummaṯ).
ʿal-diḇraṯ-še is split three ways because each morpheme holds an English word of its own ('to', 'the end', 'that'), which defeats rule 30's one-rendering condition.
'side by side with' is retained as one rendering of lə + ʿummaṯ, of which no morpheme owns a part; the head is 'side', which is also the word writing ʿummāh's own lexeme (rules 24, 30).

The italicized 'that shall be' joins the אַחַר that heads the prepositional predicate (rules 41, 49); the alternative `added` reading is named in that unit's note, and the italics corroborate without deciding (rule 7).
